I've had my dog ​​groomed here many times before. My dog ​​never seemed to dislike the shop, and I've always trusted them. However, I was very disappointed with my experience using their hotel for three nights this time.

During the stay, the shop didn't proactively contact me about my dog's condition. I later learned that my dog ​​hadn't defecated for two days, but I wasn't informed of this at the time. I also paid extra for walks, so I'm concerned about whether they checked on my dog's defecation during walks.

On the last day, my dog ​​had diarrhea. Even after bringing him home, his stool was loose and contained blood. I had to ask several times to finally get a detailed explanation of when the diarrhea started and what it was like. Also, he hadn't eaten his breakfast on the last day, but this wasn't mentioned when I picked him up. They might have been busy washing his soiled body, but I wish they had at least told me that he hadn't eaten.

At the veterinary hospital, they said the diarrhea might have been caused by stress. The cause remains unknown. However, I was worried because I didn't know that my pet hadn't defecated for two days, or that it subsequently had diarrhea, until I asked about it. I would like owners to be notified of any changes in their pet's eating habits, bowel movements, or overall health. I had trusted this shop in the past, so I was very disappointed with how they handled this situation.

I've used their services twice. The first time was good, but the second time was terrible. I think it depends on the person doing the cutting.

The second time, it wasn't just a matter of whether they could do it or not; the cut was completely different from what I ordered. I asked for the same style as last time (a short teddy bear style) with a small, rounded muzzle, but they arbitrarily gave my dog ​​a long, rounded lamb cut, and didn't even seem to realize they'd made a mistake.

My dog ​​was complaining of some pain in his paw, so I checked his paw pads and found bleeding and several cuts. However, there was no explanation when I picked him up; they only explained the cost-related issues like matting, which made me sad when I saw the injuries, and I wondered if they really cared about my dog.

Although I signed a consent form regarding accidents and injuries when dropping off my dog, I think they should have at least given some explanation.

I've changed grooming salons several times due to moving, etc., but other salons explained even minor injuries, so I'm going to switch to another salon before something serious happens.
